scripts.dev:all: bash -lc 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; npm run -w sonus-backend dev & npm run -w sonus-react dev & wait'
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run -w sonus-backend test:srs && npm run -w sonus-backend test:auth-contract && npm run -w sonus-backend test:core:local
scripts.lint: npm run -w sonus-react lint && npm run -w sonus-backend lint
scripts.build: npm run -w sonus-react build && npm run -w sonus-backend build
scripts.a11y:check: bash -lc 'set -e; npm --prefix sonus-react run build; npm --prefix sonus-react run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 > /tmp/sonus-preview.log 2>&1 & PREVIEW_PID=$!; trap "kill $PREVIEW_PID" EXIT; npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.14.x autorun --config=sonus-react/.lighthouserc.json'
scripts.codehealth:cycles: bash -lc 'npx --yes madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx backend/src && npx --yes madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx sonus-react/src'
scripts.codehealth: npm run codehealth:dead && npm run codehealth:deps && npm run codehealth:cycles && npm run codehealth:scan
